I read this as Implementation - Implement production fixes in TerminalSplitView.tsx and tabDragTypes.ts to turn the terminal, pane-handle, and browser pane-edge drop tests green.

### Implementation Summary
- **`ui/src/components/tab-dnd/tabDragTypes.ts`**:
  - Recognized `"pane-edge"` in `isWorkspaceDropData` and added `PaneEdgeDropData`.
  - Added `sourcePaneId` and `sourceSessionId` to `PaneDragData` with backwards compatibility.
  - Added `"move-tab-to-pane-split"` and `"move-pane-to-pane-split"` to `WorkspaceDropCommand`.
  - Updated `resolveWorkspaceDropCommand` to resolve tab-to-pane-edge and pane-handle-to-pane-edge drops with split direction/position.
  - Adjusted `dropPriority` so pane edge drops take highest priority over group edges, tab strips, and group body drop zones.
- **`ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`**:
  - Mounted `<PaneEdgeDropZones tabId={tab.id} leafId={leafId} />` on every rendered pane leaf.
  - Updated `useDraggable` in `PaneLeafView` to pass payload `{ type: "pane", tabId, sourcePaneId, sourceSessionId }` and kept pane handles draggable (`disabled: false`) even for single-pane tabs.
  - Added drop handling for `"move-tab-to-pane-split"` and `"move-pane-to-pane-split"` to invoke `onMoveTabToSplit` with the target pane metadata `{ tabId, leafId }`, orchestrating pane detach via `onDetachPaneToTab` for multi-pane sources and direct routing for single-pane sources.
